name: start-theme
description: SSR-driven theming for TanStack Start. The theme lives in a cookie, so the server always knows it — no flash of the wrong theme, no hydration warnings.
author: vk-hr <viktor.harhatt@gmail.com>

scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.build:js: NODE_ENV=production bun build src/index.ts src/server.ts --outdir dist --clean --format esm --target browser --splitting --sourcemap --external react --external react/jsx-runtime --external @tanstack/react-router --external @tanstack/react-start --external @tanstack/react-start/server
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run check && bun test && bun run build
